apposite: Ad + ponere: placed near. An apposite quotation.
asperity: Asper: rough. The asperity of his tone.
corollary: Corolla: little garland: a bonus. A corollary of the theorem.
cosset: Cosset: pet lamb. Cosset the child.
crestfallen: Crest fallen: a rooster loses. Crestfallen after rejection.
decry: De + crier: cry down. Decry the policy.
denouement: Dénouer: untie a knot. The denouement of the play.
encumber: En + combrer: burden. Encumbered by debt.
firebrand: Fire + brand: burning torch. A firebrand orator.
hobble: Hobble: tie legs. Hobbled by injury.
hubris: Hybris: insolence. Hubris led to his fall.
immure: In + murus: wall in. Immured in a cell.
impetuous: Impetere: rush at. An impetuous youth.
improvident: In + providere: no foresight. Improvident spending.
intimation: Intimare: hint. An intimation of trouble.
inure: In + ure: use. Inured to cold.
nonchalant: Non + chaloir: not caring. Nonchalant shrug.
patent: Patere: lie open. A patent lie.
peripatetic: Peri + patein: walk around. A peripatetic teacher.
presentiment: Pre + sentire: feel before. A presentiment of doom.
rarefied: Rarus: thin. The rarefied air of academia.
recrimination: Re + criminari: accuse back. Mutual recriminations.
stalwart: Stal + worth: sturdy. A stalwart supporter.
subterfuge: Subter + fugere: flee secretly. By subterfuge.
surreptitious: Sub + rapere: take secretly. A surreptitious glance.
unflappable: Not flap: no panic. An unflappable nurse.
